fact: Prime Ministerial Decree No. 207 of 2026, dated 18 January 2026, re-forms the 2019 National Council for AI as the National Council for Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies, chaired by the ICT Minister and meeting at least monthly.
title: قرار رئيس مجلس الوزراء رقم 207 لسنة 2026
